turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? You gave my son a zero.
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite for what? On what evidence?
Nothing is agreed, Hale. The zero is still there, and you haven't shown me one thing.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing. But you still haven't told me what you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero come off Owen's grade today, that you put in writing that nothing will go on his record, and that you show me whatever evidence you have. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position: she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the evidence in front of her, and she has not agreed to anything. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you were not there yet because the rewrite was offered with no evidence behind it.
What moved her: You said the rewrite would replace the zero and leave nothing on his record, which met her demand about his file, though only a little, because you hadn't shown her anything yet.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite twice without saying what it was for, so she kept asking what you had and you gave her nothing to check.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, because you showed none. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After owning that the zero went in before you called her, put one dated document in front of her, such as the version history or a booking log, before you mention the rewrite.
